name: frqncy-app
description: FRQNCY mobile app — wellness platform with wake/sleep alarm feature. Hybrid Capacitor.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:run: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.ios:run: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run ios

_plugins_comment: Minimum viable shell only — all official @capacitor/* plugins that definitely support Cap 7. Audio/video/SQLite/downloader plugins get added one at a time when we wire each feature, so a single bad peer-dep can't block the whole install.
